description.zh: 通过实例描述称进行过滤，支持模糊匹配。
description.en: Filters instances by description. Fuzzy matching is supported.

description.zh: 实例类型，vector(向量索引版)，engine(召回引擎版)
description.en: The edition of the instance. Valid values: vector (Vector Search Edition) and engine (Retrieval Engine Edition).
The page number. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 指定每页展示条数，默认为10，限制:[1-50]
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10. The value must be in the range of 1 to 50.
The ID of the resource group.
